channel.title: RVA Figure Drawing
channel.description: Figure drawing sessions in Richmond, VA

item.title: Wed, Oct 14 · 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM — Figure Drawing - 10/14
item.description: Location: Studio Two Three, 109 W 15th St, Richmond, VA 23224 | Cost: $20 | 3 hour figure drawing workshop with a professional nude model. Instructor Carter Helmandollar calls the poses, from gestural to long poses. Bring your own materials. No photography.

item.title: Sat, Oct 17 · 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM — Figure Drawing Workshop [29]
item.description: Location: VMFA Studio School, 200 N Arthur Ashe Boulevard, Richmond, VA 23220 | Cost: Member $80 / Adult $95 | Explore drawings of the human form by other artists, then work from a live model with instructor Amy Smith to create expressive portraits in charcoal and pencil. Prerequisite: basic drawing skills.

item.title: Sun, Oct 18 · 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM — Figure Drawing Open Session - October 18, 2026
item.description: Location: Art Works Inc, 320 Hull Street, Richmond, VA 23224 | Cost: Free | Open Figure Drawing Session

item.title: Wed, Oct 21 · 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM — October Queer Life Drawing
item.description: Location: Gold Lion Community Cafe, 1012 Hull Street, Richmond, VA 23224 | Cost: Suggested donation $10 | Chill vibe life drawing sesh celebrating queer bodies and creativity, come draw and hang out in person!
